title: Scene Brief
description: Authored intent for a rendered scene. Measurement proves detail exists; the brief proves the detail was designed.

fantasy.description: The moment in one concrete sentence. Praise words such as epic or beautiful are rejected.

focalPoint.description: The subject and how the eye is led to it.

lighting.description: Key direction, mood, and where the shadow anchors are.

palette.description: Binding to the aesthetic profile or palette roles.

camera.description: Which camera approves this scene: distance, FOV, framing.

storyDetails.description: Traces that prove the space is used: wear, repairs, stains, left-behind objects.

negativeSpace.description: Where quiet is intentional, so the gate does not read it as neglect.
